configurePresets.name: windows
configurePresets.description: The native build. 32-bit because the loader has to share the game's address space.

configurePresets.name: windows-x64
configurePresets.displayName: Windows - MSVC (Visual Studio 2022, x64), the standalone driving engine
configurePresets.description: 64-bit: driving_standalone and driving_standalone_test only, x87 off. See docs/driving/64-bit.md.

configurePresets.name: macos
configurePresets.displayName: macOS - clang with the mingw-w64 sysroot, cross-compiling to Windows
configurePresets.description: Needs mingw-w64 and ninja. Works on Linux too. See docs/macos-build.md.

configurePresets.name: linux
configurePresets.displayName: Linux - clang with the distribution's mingw-w64 sysroot, cross-compiling to Windows
configurePresets.description: Needs clang, ninja and the i686 mingw-w64 packages. Same toolchain file as macOS; see docs/macos-build.md.

configurePresets.name: linux-i386
configurePresets.displayName: Linux - native 32-bit x86 with clang, the standalone driving engine
configurePresets.description: SDL3 and dxvk-native; FFmpeg 8.0 from tools/fmv/build_ffmpeg.sh linux-i386. See docs/driving/portable.md.

configurePresets.name: linux-x64
configurePresets.displayName: Linux - native x86-64 with clang, the standalone driving engine
configurePresets.description: 64-bit: SDL3 and dxvk-native; FFmpeg 8.0 from tools/fmv/build_ffmpeg.sh linux-x86_64. See docs/driving/64-bit.md.

configurePresets.name: macos-arm64
configurePresets.displayName: macOS - Apple clang, native arm64, the standalone driving engine
configurePresets.description: SDL3, its GPU API on Metal; FFmpeg 8.0 from tools/fmv/build_ffmpeg.sh macos-arm64. See docs/driving/macos.md.
